finding: 9 of 15 datasets are wholly or nearly wholly collapsed; UTKFace and FairFace have EVERY algorithm below the floor, i.e. the failure is in the label/partition/evaluator, not in any algorithm.
quantified evidence: ADULT 100%, DRUG 100%, FairFace 100%, UTKFace 100%, CREMA-D 96%, CREMA-D_gender 94%, RAVDESS 94%, BANK 87%, LFWA+ 82%
impact on reporting: ADULT and DRUG must be removed from the main table (appendix S7). UTKFace / FairFace / LFWA+ / CREMA-D* / RAVDESS produce no usable number for any algorithm.

finding: FairFed reproduces FedAvg bit-for-bit, so the FairFed column carries no information about FairFed.
quantified evidence: 33 (dataset, K, split) cells identical on ACC+ACC_gap+DEO: ADULT/K20/Dirichlet01, ADULT/K20/Dirichlet05, ADULT/K20/Dirichlet1, ADULT/K20/Uniform, BANK/K20/Dirichlet05, BANK/K20/Uniform, BANK/K30/Dirichlet01, BANK/K30/Dirichlet05
impact on reporting: FairFed cannot be used as a comparison point on those datasets until the implementation is fixed.

finding: mFairFL reproduces FedAvg bit-for-bit on some datasets.
quantified evidence: 5 cells identical: ADULT/K20/Dirichlet01, ADULT/K20/Dirichlet05, ADULT/K4/Dirichlet05, CREMA-D/K20/Dirichlet1, RAVDESS/K20/Speaker

finding: FedRenyi lambda has no effect: lam0p25 / lam0p5 / lam1 / lam2 give identical numbers on DRUG.
quantified evidence: 4 variant dirs, identical ACC/ACC_gap/DEO on DRUG
impact on reporting: The Renyi fairness-strength ablation cannot be reported.

finding: COMPAS and DRUG 20Clients directories mix PDFFed ablation variants and lambda sweeps with the main comparison, at nsp=1-2 only.
quantified evidence: COMPAS K=20 holds 76 distinct algorithm directories
impact on reporting: Any ranking that does not filter these is meaningless; they are excluded here by the ABLATION regex.

finding: CelebA has no PDFFed (non-DP) and no LoGoFair result at all; UTKFace K=30/40 has no PDFFed-family result.
quantified evidence: CelebA main algorithms present: FL_FairBatch, FairFed, FedAvg, FedFair, FedNova, FedProto, FedProx, FedRenyi, FederatedAverageWithPo, PDFFed_DP, Scaffold, mFairFL | UTKFace algorithms present: FL_FairBatch, FairFed, FedAvg, FedFair, FedNova, FedProto, FedProx, FederatedAverageWithPo, PDFFed_DP_eps1, PDFFed_DP_eps100, PDFFed_DP_eps1000, PDFFed_DP_eps1e+06, PDFFed_DP_eps20, PDFFed_DP_eps50, PDFFed_DP_eps8, Scaffold
impact on reporting: CelebA can only support a PDFFed_DP claim, and only 3 algorithms reach nsp=4 there, so the group is too thin to rank.

finding: .31 result tree contains algorithms belonging to another project, some without ACC_gap/HM at all.
quantified evidence: DOSFL, FedFACT, FedMix, NaiveMix, OSFL, PraFFL, ProxProbability
impact on reporting: They show up as NaN rows and must be filtered before any ranking.

finding: Cells whose json is missing or whose partition fingerprint is not in the local cache cannot be assigned a floor or a commit.
quantified evidence: 97 cells: ADULT=5, COMPAS=33, CelebA=2, DRUG=24, DUTCH=24, LFWA+=2, moji=7
impact on reporting: They are excluded from every collapse statistic and cannot enter a single-commit table.

finding: The same cell key run on two machines / two commits disagrees on ACC.
impact on reporting: Fix per appendix S9.1: publish from ONE commit, do not re-run. Selection rule fixed a priori to newest recorded_at.

finding: PDFFed wins HM/ACC but ranks mid-to-low on ACC_gap and DEO in the same groups, so the HM win is driven by accuracy, not by narrowing unfairness.
impact on reporting: Any claim of a fairness advantage must be made on CelebA PDFFed_DP only (DEO rank 1), and must not be inferred from HM.

finding: balance_sampling=1 was turned on for 20 cells (0 in the 2026-10-21 audit) but every one of them is still collapsed.
quantified evidence: 20 cells, all on RAVDESS (floor 0.8667) and CREMA-D_gender (floor 0.8293)
impact on reporting: Label-balanced sampling does not rescue high-floor datasets; the collapse cause is elsewhere.
